'''Auntea Jenny Shanghai Industrial Co., Ltd.''' ({{Lang-zh|c=沪上阿姨|p=Hù shàng āyí|l=Auntie Shanghai}}) is a Chinese [[milk tea]] chain. As of 2025, the brand had opened 9,367 locations<ref name="aj-nbd-2025">{{Cite Q|Q138208656}}</ref>, making it one of [[List of the largest fast food restaurant chains|the largest tea franchises in the world]].

Auntea Jenny began trading on the [[Hong Kong Stock Exchange]] in May 2025 after raising K$273 million with a listing price of HK$113.12.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Li |first=Diana |date=7 May 2025 |title=Bubble Tea Couple's Wealth Hits $1.7 Billion on Hong Kong IPO |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-05-07/auntea-jenny-founders-are-billionaires-after-bubble-tea-chain-s-hong-kong-ipo |access-date=28 May 2025 |website=[[Bloomberg News]]}}</ref>

== History ==
Auntea Jenny was founded by husband-and-wife Shan Weijun and Zhou Rongrong in 2013.<ref name=":1" /> On July 18, 2013, its first store opened in [[People's Square (Shanghai)|People's Square]] of [[Shanghai]], and became successful with monthly profits of over 400,000 yuan.<ref>{{Cite web |last=腾讯网 |date=2023-07-24 |title=坐拥6500门店的"沪上阿姨"公布IPO计划！新茶饮争夺下一个"万店"头衔{{!}}消费新势力_腾讯新闻 |url=https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20230724A08MCA00 |access-date=2025-06-12 |website=news.qq.com |language=zh-CN}}</ref>

In the years after its founding, Auntea Jenny expanded rapidly, focusing on [[Chinese city tier system|lower-tier cities]] for development. In 2018, there were over one thousand stores nationwide. In 2019, the brand changed its logo to a woman with a bun, wearing a [[cheongsam]] and holding a cup of milk tea. By 2020, the total number of stores exceeded 2,000,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ziyang |first=Wang |date=2020-11-24 |title=茶饮品牌沪上阿姨完成近亿元A轮融资 — 新京报 |url=https://www.bjnews.com.cn/detail/160618948115077.html |access-date=2025-06-12 |website=www.bjnews.com.cn}}</ref>  and completed a nearly RMB 100 million Series A financing round with Jiayu Capital. <ref>{{Cite web |title=“茶饮品牌沪上阿姨完成近亿元A轮融资 — 新京报” |url=https://www.bjnews.com.cn/detail/160618948115077.html |access-date=2026-03-20 |website=www.bjnews.com.cn|trans-title=‘Tea beverage brand Shanghai Auntie completes nearly 100 million yuan Series A financing — Beijing News’}}</ref>By 2023 the number of stores had grown to over 6,000.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-05 |title=沪上阿姨：激烈市场竞争中 新式茶饮如何脱颖而出-新华网 |url=http://www.news.cn/food/20230505/74af86f6e51941ceb32d5e1b8a8ffec0/c.html |access-date=2025-06-12 |website=www.news.cn}}</ref>

In February 2023, an illustration on the packaging of the brand's tea cup sparked debate on Chinese social media. The illustration showed a woman wearing a high-cut cheongsam with her thigh exposed at the slit. Posts on [[Weibo]] about the image received more than 290 million views, with some users criticizing the advertisement as overly sexualized, while others defended the image.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Feng |first=Jenny |date=2023-02-23 |title=A Chinese debate about sexualization in advertising |url=https://thechinaproject.com/2023/02/23/a-chinese-debate-about-sexualization-in-advertising/ |access-date=2025-06-03 |website=The China Project |language=en-US}}</ref> The Jinshan Market Supervision Bureau reviewed the image and found it did not violate Chinese advertising law.<ref>{{Cite web |date=25 February 2023 |title=上海市金山区市监局："沪上阿姨"女子穿旗袍图片，不违法 |url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_22073885 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230226042901/https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_22073885 |archive-date=26 February 2023 |access-date=10 June 2025 |website=澎湃新闻}}</ref>

In February 2024, Auntea Jenny opened its first overseas location opened in [[Kuala Lumpur|Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=沪上阿姨海外首店落地马来西亚；金龙鱼五常大米被曝以次充好_央广网 |url=https://ent.cnr.cn/canyin/zixun/20240307/t20240307_526620000.shtml |access-date=2025-06-12 |website=ent.cnr.cn}}</ref> Later that year, the brand updated their logo to its current iteration, featuring a smiling woman with a bob shaped haircut, colored in orange.

On May 8, 2025, the company went public through an [[initial public offering]] on the [[Hong Kong Stock Exchange]], raising HK$273 million (US$35 million). During the same month, Auntea Jenny launched its first American location in [[Queens|Queens, New York]]. The two founders have an estimated combined net worth of US$1.7 billion.<ref name=":1" />

In February 2026, the company opened a store in [[Soho]], [[London]].<ref>{{Cite web |author=<!-- not stated --> |date=2026-02-10 |title=AUNTEA JENNY LONDON |url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DUlKrHMjWQd/ |website=instagram.com |access-date=2026-02-11}}</ref>
